easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Phantom Steed must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed for its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
